conventions.scope: Only completed formal learned trials are audited; development trials are excluded. Raw recordings/model remain unchanged.
conventions.proposed: Unfiltered 20Hz planner proposals, including shared virtual contact preload and any counted fallback.
conventions.executed: The actual accepted/interpolated 500Hz body and foot command logged by the executor, not measured tracking state or a separately logged endpoint.
conventions.model_effect: Before any fallback, compare each proposal against the initial conditioned distribution evaluated at the SAME learned phase, with identical shared preload. Differences isolate later belief/reference conditioning from normal trajectory progress.
conventions.timing: Learned duration is a distribution prediction, not observed completion time. Planner remaining time reaches zero at model phase1; subsequent bounded recovery time is not included in that prediction.
conventions.fallback_time: Count times50ms sums nominal planning horizons, NOT elapsed time: contact-freeze/resume can trigger extra updates. Actual first-fallback-to-confirmed-reload span and accumulated active downward-command samples are reported separately.
conventions.attribution: This observational audit cannot causally prove a learned-planner advantage. Model-driven references, servo preload, feedback tracking, feasibility limits and fallback all affect final success.
